findings.F1: In the choppy profile, the coin's 30-day return points the way of its move over the next 10 days. On the 10-day grid the Spearman correlation of the 30-day return with the unusual move is 0.38 (157 cases, p 1e-6), and 0.27 over 5 days (306 cases, p 1e-6). Outside the choppy profile it is only 0.04 (737 cases, p 0.32), so the effect lives in the choppy market.
findings.F2: The effect is carried by falls and is graded. Among choppy cases with a negative 30-day return, the 10-day unusual move is +3.7 % (t 1.15, 28 cases) for the shallowest third of falls (mean -3.7 %), -5.9 % (t -1.82, 27 cases) for the middle third, and -13.8 % (t -4.58, 28 cases) for the deepest third (mean -26 %). The Spearman correlation within falls is 0.53 (83 cases, p 3e-7). Over 5 days the same thirds give -0.5 %, -4.0 % and -7.9 % (t -2.59, 54 cases).
findings.F3: After rises the continuation is weaker and cannot be told from chance. In the choppy profile the strongest third of rises has a 10-day unusual move of +16.1 % (t 1.26, 25 cases), and the correlation within rises is 0.10 (p 0.40).
findings.F4: The tested 20-day horizon is too long for this effect. At 20 days the choppy correlation drops to 0.23 (68 cases, p 0.06) and the quintiles are not ordered. This matches step 5's +0.75 % unusual move (t 0.45) at 20 days, against -13.8 % at 10 days for deep falls in F2.
findings.F5: Scaling the 30-day return by the coin's 30-day swing keeps the gradient. In the choppy profile the correlation is 0.33 at 10 days (157 cases, p 2e-5). The two most negative quintiles give 10-day unusual moves of -9.3 % (t -2.59, 32 cases) and -7.4 % (t -2.15, 31 cases).
findings.F6: The fall effect is not stable across years.
findings.F7: The book does not capture the move after its own shorts. Its choppy-profile shorts on negative 30-day returns were followed by a 5-day coin move of -3.0 % (151 cases). It also held 378 short cases outside the choppy profile, carried there by the 20-bar minimum holding. Of these, 86 came after positive 30-day returns and were followed by a +4.4 % 5-day rise. This is where its losses (Sharpe -0.20) sit.
findings.F8: Off the theme and outside the choppy profile, a strong 7-day rise scaled by the coin's swing is followed by a 10-day unusual move of +5.6 % (t 2.88, 164 cases, top quintile). With the many angles looked at, this is weak, and it repeats the rising-market continuation ideas the map already holds, so it is not proposed.

ideas.idea: In a choppy market, the larger a coin's percentage fall over the past 30 days, the more it keeps falling over the next 10 days, the continuation growing with the depth of the slide.
ideas.consequence: A short on a deep monthly slide in a flat market pays over about ten days and fades by three weeks, so it should not be held longer.
ideas.name: chop slide ten-day continuation

ideas.idea: In a choppy market, the larger a coin's 30-day fall measured against its own 30-day daily swing, the more it keeps falling over the next 10 days.
ideas.consequence: A short in a flat market should be sized by how unusual the month's fall is for that coin, not by its raw percentage.
ideas.name: chop swing-scaled slide continuation
